body.content: Counterexample-first tension: the critic stance is 'counterexample first', but the audit is adjudicating the RITUAL, not the underlying conjecture. If the ritual promotes a single shared counterexample to 'sustained', the ritual itself may be violating the counterexample-first principle by overpromoting. This is the atypical candidate (typicality 0.22) formalized.
body.why_keep_this: Captures the adversarial self-criticism of the ritual under its own school stance.
